;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] again open fire with [[tear gas]] and live ammunition on [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] protesters, following 6 weeks of protests. One person is killed and 146 others wounded, with some protesters throwing stones and burning tyres. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/gaza-protests-latest-israel-shot-dead-border-march-gunfire-palestine-sinwar-hamas-a8347366.html (''The Independent'')]
**Three [[Israeli people|Israelis]] are arrested after filming themselves attempting to fly a kite carrying an incendiary device into the [[Gaza Strip]], in reference to the same tactic used by protestors in Gaza. The kite crashes on Israeli territory where it starts a small fire. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/video-shows-israelis-failed-attempt-to-send-flaming-kite-to-gaza-1.6076149 (''Haaretz'')]
**[[Egypt]] announces that the [[Rafah Crossing]] into [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] will be opened for four days starting next Saturday. Egypt usually opens the border for [[humanitarian aid|humanitarian]] reasons every two or three months for two or three days at a time. [http://english.wafa.ps/page.aspx?id=4rE3pba97627967481a4rE3pb (Wafa.ps)]

;Disasters and accidents
*The owner of ''[[Cheeki Rafiki]]'', a yacht that capsized in the [[Atlantic]] in 2014 with the loss of four lives, is given a suspended sentence in [[England]] for the accident. He was earlier convicted of operating the vessel unsafely but acquitted of manslaughter. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-hampshire-44077513 (BBC)]
*[[Mount Merapi]] in [[Java]], [[Indonesia]], erupts. Authorities order evacuations and the closure of [[Adisucipto Airport]] in [[Yogyakarta]].  [http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/world/2018/05/java-s-merapi-volcano-erupts.html (Newshub)]
*A fire destroys almost all of the approximately 710 commercial premises of an important market in [[Lima]], Peru. The fire is exacerbated by flammable products stored in many of the stores. One person was injured and also there were allegations of [[looting]]. [https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/1240603-puente-piedra-incendio-consume-mercado-monumental-video (''La República'')] [http://www.capital.com.pe/actualidad/video-puente-piedra-asi-fue-el-incendio-que-anoche-consumio-cientos-de-puestos-de-mercado-noticia-1122034 (Radio Capital)]

;Health and environment
*[[James Harrison (blood donor)|James Harrison]], an 81-year-old [[Australia]]n whose blood was used in the development of [[Rho(D) immune globulin|a treatment]] for [[Rh disease]] that has been credited with saving the lives of over 2 million infants in his country alone, donates [[blood plasma]] for the final time, after having regularly donated for over 60 years. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/11/health/james-harrison-blood-donor-retires-trnd/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**[[Russia]]n authorities say that they foiled a plot by [[Siberia]]n terrorists to attack a [[Victory Day]] march attended by [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and visiting [[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. Twenty suspects are detained. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/russia-says-terror-attack-foiled-at-wwii-memorial-march-attended-by-netanyahu/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Foreign fighters in the Syrian and Iraqi Civil Wars]]
**[[Conservative Party of Canada|Conservative]] MP [[Candice Bergen (politician)|Candice Bergen]] calls for action on [[Abu Huzaifa al-Kanadi]], a man living in [[Toronto]] who claimed to have shot a Sunni prisoner in the head for the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] in [[Syria]]. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2018/05/11/conservative-mps-call-for-action-on-self-described-terror-recruit-for-daesh-reportedly-in-toronto.html (''The Star'')]
*[[Osmington shooting]]
**Three adults and four children are found shot dead at a property in [[Margaret River, Western Australia|Margaret River]], [[Western Australia]]. [[Australian Federal Police|Police]] suspect [[murder-suicide]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2018/may/11/margaret-river-tragedy-seven-people-found-dead-on-property-south-of-perth (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*The [[Supreme Court of the Philippines|Supreme Court]] of the [[Philippines]] votes 8–6 to grant the [[quo warranto]] petition by the [[Solicitor General of the Philippines|Solicitor General]] against [[Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines|Chief Justice]] [[Maria Lourdes Sereno]], removing her from office for violating requirements on the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/202236-sereno-ousted-supreme-court-quo-warranto-decision (Rappler)] 
*[[Poland|Polish]] MPs vote to vote to cut their pay by 20% after opposition lawmakers boycott the vote. [http://www.dw.com/en/poland-slashes-lawmakers-pay-by-20-percent-after-hard-work-bonuses/a-43747376 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Science and technology
*[[2018 in spaceflight]]
**[[SpaceX]] launches [[Bangabandhu-1]], [[Bangladesh]]'s first [[Geostationary orbit|geostationary]] [[communications satellite]], from [[Cape Canaveral Air Force Station]] in [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [http://uk.businessinsider.com/spacex-rocket-launch-falcon-9-block-5-live-webcast-2018-5 (''Business Insider'')]
*Scientists at [[MetService]] record a wave measuring {{convert|23.8|m|ft}} high in the [[Southern Ocean]] near [[Campbell Island, New Zealand|Campbell Island]], [[New Zealand]], making it the largest wave ever recorded in the [[Southern Hemisphere]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-44078255 (BBC)] [http://www.foxnews.com/science/2018/05/11/massive-wave-sets-southern-hemisphere-record-scientists-say.html (Fox News)]
